This was the left-hand part of the army.

This walked behind for the protection of the army. With the army there were storytellers who told tales of bravery. Along with the army they also received physical training. According to need and occasion changes were also made in the rules of war.

The amirs of Andalus had divided Andalus into six provinces. The chief ruler of a province was called wali. He was also the commander of the army stationed in the province. The supplies and expenses of the army too were the responsibility of the wali.

sections.title: سبق 38 — متن (201)

paras.text: Exercise questions
paras.urdu: مشقی سوالات
paras.pashto: تمریني پوښتنې

paras.text: 1. Take a brief review of the era of government of the Nasrid dynasty.
paras.urdu: ۱۔ نصری خاندان کے دورِ حکومت کا مختصراً جائزہ لیں۔
paras.pashto: ۱. د نصري کورنۍ د حکومت د دورې لنډه کتنه وکړئ.

paras.text: 2. What were the causes of the decline of the Islamic sultanate in Andalus?
paras.urdu: ۲۔ اندلس میں اسلامی سلطنت کے زوال کے اسباب کیا تھے؟
paras.pashto: ۲. په اندلس کې د اسلامي سلطنت د زوال لاملونه څه وو؟

paras.text: 3. Throw light on the administration of the sultanate of the Banu Umayyah in Andalus.
paras.urdu: ۳۔ اندلس میں بنو امیہ کے انتظامِ سلطنت پر روشنی ڈالئے۔
paras.pashto: ۳. په اندلس کې د بنو امیه د سلطنت پر اداره رڼا واچوئ.

paras.text: 4. Fill in the blanks with the correct words:
paras.urdu: ۴۔ خالی جگہیں درست الفاظ سے پر کریں:
paras.pashto: ۴. تشې په سمو کلمو ډکې کړئ:

paras.text: a. Muhammad adopted the title of ______ in Granada.

paras.text: g. The middle part of the army was called ______.
paras.urdu: ز: فوج کا درمیانی حصہ ______ کہلاتا تھا۔
paras.pashto: ز. د پوځ منځنۍ برخه ______ بلل کېده.

paras.text: h. The right part of the army was called ______ and the left part ______.

f. The head of hijabah was called ______.

g. The middle part of the army was called ______.

h. The right part of the army was called ______ and the left part ______.
